examInfo.examName: English Literature - Modern Era - (All Gov. Job)

questions.subject: English
questions.q: Who is considered the most important poet of the Modern Era?
questions.explain: T.S. Eliot (1888-1965) is the leading poet of Modernism. His work 'The Waste Land' (1922) is the landmark of modern poetry.

questions.subject: English
questions.q: 'The Waste Land' is written by?
questions.explain: The Waste Land (1922) is written by T.S. Eliot. It has 5 sections.

questions.subject: English
questions.q: Who wrote the novel '1984'?
questions.explain: 1984 (1949) and Animal Farm (1945) are written by George Orwell. Modern dystopian literature.

questions.subject: English
questions.q: 'Ulysses' is a novel by?
questions.explain: Ulysses (1922) by James Joyce is the most famous modernist novel. It uses stream of consciousness technique.

questions.subject: English
questions.q: Who is the author of 'Mrs. Dalloway'?
questions.explain: Mrs. Dalloway (1925) by Virginia Woolf. She is famous for stream of consciousness technique.

questions.subject: English
questions.q: Modern Era in English literature is generally considered from?
questions.explain: Modern Era is generally 1901-1939. After 1939 is Post-Modern Era. Some say 1890-1945.

questions.subject: English
questions.q: Which play is written by G.B. Shaw?
questions.explain: Man and Superman (1903), Arms and the Man are by G.B. Shaw. He got Nobel in 1925.

questions.subject: English
questions.q: W.B. Yeats won Nobel Prize in?
questions.explain: W.B. Yeats won Nobel in 1923 for literature. He is Irish poet of Modern Era.

questions.subject: English
questions.q: 'The Old Man and the Sea' is written by?
questions.explain: Ernest Hemingway wrote The Old Man and the Sea (1952). He won Nobel in 1954.

questions.subject: English
questions.q: Who wrote 'A Passage to India'?
questions.explain: A Passage to India (1924) by E.M. Forster deals with British India.

questions.subject: English
questions.q: 'The Great Gatsby' is written by?
questions.explain: The Great Gatsby (1925) by F. Scott Fitzgerald is a classic of American Modernism.

questions.subject: English
questions.q: Which is the famous poem of W.H. Auden?
questions.explain: The Unknown Citizen (1939) by W.H. Auden is modern poem. The Second Coming is by Yeats.

questions.subject: English
questions.q: 'Waiting for Godot' is a play by?
questions.explain: Waiting for Godot (1953) by Samuel Beckett. It is Theatre of the Absurd.

questions.subject: English
questions.q: Who is known as the father of stream of consciousness?
questions.explain: Term 'stream of consciousness' was first used by psychologist William James. In literature, James Joyce and Virginia Woolf popularized it.

questions.subject: English
questions.q: 'Heart of Darkness' is written by?
questions.explain: Heart of Darkness (1899) by Joseph Conrad. Considered early modernism.

questions.subject: English
questions.q: Which novel is NOT written by D.H. Lawrence?
questions.explain: A Passage to India is by Forster. Other three are by D.H. Lawrence.

questions.subject: English
questions.q: 'Sailing to Byzantium' is a poem by?
questions.explain: Sailing to Byzantium (1928) and The Second Coming are famous poems by W.B. Yeats.

questions.subject: English
questions.q: Who wrote 'The Grapes of Wrath'?
questions.explain: The Grapes of Wrath (1939) by John Steinbeck won Pulitzer in 1940.

questions.subject: English
questions.q: Modernism is characterized by?
questions.explain: Modernism features break with tradition, stream of consciousness, fragmentation, alienation, pessimism after WWI.

questions.subject: English
questions.q: Which work belongs to the Modern Era?
questions.explain: The Waste Land (1922) is Modern. Paradise Lost is Neoclassical, Pride and Prejudice is Romantic era novel, Hamlet is Renaissance.
